question: What quality is attributed to the mantra when it is of this kind?
premises: The mantra is described conditionally as being of such a kind.
Swift accomplishment is attributed to it.
It is characterized as giving siddhi.
inference: Such a mantra is said to grant siddhi swiftly.
uncertainties: The exact condition indicated by cedṛṅ is not fully specified in this verse alone.
plain_english: If the mantra is of this kind, it grants accomplishment swiftly.
